{{Top|leg}}
The '''molecular microscope''' was a high-powered multi-spectrum [[Microscope/Legends|microscope]] produced by [[TelBrinTel Corporation]].

Designed for use in [[Science Research Droid]]s, the microscope was small enough to fit in the droids' single stalk-like [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] and was used to great effect in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] chemical weapons research. The microscope was so effective that it was also used in the civilian version of the [[Science Research Droid]], the [[S2R(A) Science Droid]].
